description_excerpt: JOB PURPOSE Based in Hanoi, the Manager - Maersk Ground Freight Business Development and Solutions is responsible for developing the full MGF portfolio in North Vietnam under one integrated product scope. The portfolio includes domestic transportation and cross-border ground transportation. The role is in business development, customer solution design , pricing, vendors network and commercial coordination.
